pages.title: Four materials per cube
pages.text: Each front-panel area holds one item type with room for 64 stacks. For items stacking to 64, that is 4,096 items per area.$(br2)$(li)Right-click with an item to insert the held stack.$(li)Double right-click an established area to deposit matching items from your inventory.

pages.title: Taking items out
pages.text: $(li)Left-click an item area to take one item.$(li)Sneak-left-click to take up to a stack.$(br2)Automation can also move items through the cube.$(br2)A locked cube opens its access panel instead. Present its matching storage Key Card to toggle the lock. A door card does not automatically grant storage access.
